questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem: Ramesh has used the water of an irrigation source to move his fields from ordinary crops to water intensive and commercial crops, and he is now worried because the soil of these fields is turning saline. Consider the following statements. 1. Irrigation has changed the cropping pattern of many regions, with farmers shifting to water intensive and commercial crops. 2. This shift has great ecological consequences like the salinisation of the soil. Choose the correct option. (A) Both the assertion and the reason are true and the reason is a correct explanation of the assertion. (B) Both the assertion and the reason are true but the reason is not a correct explanation of the assertion. (C) The assertion is true but the reason is false. (D) Both the assertion and the reason are false.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: Both the assertion and the reason are true and the reason is a correct explanation of the assertion.

The Sardar Sarovar Project was built to meet the requirement of water in areas that are neither drought-prone nor desert. Choose the correct option. (A) Both the assertion and the reason are true and the reason is a correct explanation of the assertion. (B) Both the assertion and the reason are true but the reason is not a correct explanation of the assertion. (C) The assertion is true but the reason is false. (D) Both the assertion and the reason are false.

questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem: A farmer in a village hears that a central programme promises every agricultural farm in the country some means of protective irrigation, and he wants to know exactly what that programme sets out to do. Consider the following statements. 1. The Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana has been started which ensures access to some means to protective irrigation for all agricultural farms in the country, thus bringing much the desired rural prosperity. 2. One of the broad objectives of this programme is to introduce sustainable water conservation practices. Choose the correct option. (A) Both the assertion and the reason are true and the reason is a correct explanation of the assertion. (B) Both the assertion and the reason are true but the reason is not a correct explanation of the assertion. (C) The assertion is true but the reason is false. (D) Both the assertion and the reason are false.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: Both the assertion and the reason are true but the reason is not a correct explanation of the assertion.
